work.name: Margadarshaka

Set stage gates on demand, delivery economics, and human-review cost - testing each before authorising the next build tranche.
Ran Margadarshaka's pre-scale GTM as gated experiments - demand tests, counsellor capacity checks, and unit-economics checkpoints before marketing spend.
Drafted early cap-table scenarios and angel-outreach materials while mapping investor fit against counselling-liability and payer-user alignment risks.
Prototyped a Whisper/C++ edge inference path to hold per-call compute inside the INR 50 ceiling - bounded automation before full voice-stack spend.
Designed a psychometric intake layer for career-guidance flows - translating trait signals into counsellor-ready prompts without automating judgment calls.
Ran structured discovery with six-plus practitioners on how AI-assisted career guidance is shifting - synthesising forecasts into product and positioning choices.
Framed a low-price-point, SDG-aligned access path for regional-language counselling - stress-testing affordability without compromising safeguarding spend.
Ran Margadarshaka delivery in two-week Scrum cadences - backlog grooming, design handoffs, and Kanban visibility across engineering and counselling stakeholders.
Turned post-call transcripts into structured case dossiers and counsellor dashboards - linking entities, session history, and follow-up tasks in one view.

work.name: Savi Hotels & Resorts

highlights.text: Completed property handover by running site analysis, verifying room and F&B inventory, and formulating operating agreements - then fitted the meeting room and banquet spaces to a bookable standard before the first guest weeks.

Ran the property through the first operating weeks after handover - front desk, staffing, rooms product, and event-space readiness - while designing mobile-first workflows so paper completion did not become an empty building.

Grew weekly rooms from four room-nights at takeover to a peak week of five full-property sell-out days - market timing helped, but the ramp held only after corporate MICE banquets ran morning to evening and walk-in family lunches shared the same kitchen and service spine.

Triggered a two-month profitability kill gate when leasing velocity and contribution stayed below threshold - returning the property with offboarding records, inventory state, and a reusable pitchbook rather than extending a failed hold thesis.

Increased repeat bookings by 30% within 6 months across 4 hotels by routing structured guest feedback into reception script updates, staffing changes, and amenity fixes reviewed in a weekly ops cadence.
Improved continuity between reception shifts through a shared handover queue for reservations, arrivals, payments, special requests, and service recovery.
Automated cash and shift reconciliation with a 14-sheet OpenPyXL workbook, replacing manual cross-checks with an auditable front desk control process.

Advanced qualified buyer and management leads by presenting property pitchbooks, walking clients through operating economics and turnaround evidence, and managing follow-up through the business-development cycle.

Kept a five-workstation, eleven-drive hotel IT estate live through the turnaround by running cabling, storage health checks, and downtime-window patches so front desk and back office did not drop during peak service.

Operated guest WiFi across property gateways with per-arrival password rotation instead of shared lobby credentials, then extended network topology when a new router was added so mesh routing stayed coherent for rooms and back office.

Supported four repeat corporate events for decade-long clients - leading three on-site and overseeing two while off-site - by standing up meeting and banquet spaces, QA-ing buffet timing and staff readiness, and recovering live service when managers cut corners.
Facilitated a milestone birthday and baby-shower package end to end - aligning decor vendors, artisanal menu choices, and live service recovery when mid-level managers cut corners on the floor.

Locked the demand spike into sustained commercial forms - repeat corporate packages, alternate booking structures beyond ad-hoc nights, and written operating playbooks - so rooms, banquet dayparts, and walk-in F&B could hold volume after the peak week.

Hosted amicable pre-meeting and post-meeting dinners around corporate bookings - and for venture-facing cohorts, tasteful team dinners - using kitchen timing and event-space ambience as relationship infrastructure beyond bare room hire.

Took entrepreneurship-through-acquisition operating control of the leased hotel after site analysis, inventory verification, and agreement formulation - then stood up meeting and banquet spaces before the first revenue weeks.

Designed corporate MICE catering end to end - menu architecture, bill-of-materials, and item sourcing - so banquet dayparts could run morning to evening without improvised kitchen ordering on the same property as rooms ops.
Built rotational pop-up menus for family and youth walk-in crowds, varying price architecture and dish sets so daytime F&B was not only corporate buffet overflow.
Partnered with head chefs on kitchen upkeep and production standards, and stepped into unofficial banquet production oversight when coverage gaps hit - without claiming a formal hotel line-cook role.

projects.name: Adaptive Efficiency - BWC
projects.description: Adaptive-efficiency investment desk on USD 1 million simulated StockTrak capital: regime overlays, IPS governance, tariff-shock hedging, and committee postmortem linked to Project GANET.

highlights.text: Ran a USD 1 million StockTrak mandate as simulated capital under IPS single-name caps and bi-weekly committee diaries - eight people, firewalled from live brokerage - with factor sleeves and GANET-informed macro overlays across AI, defence, financials, and defensive retail.
Moved into cash and inverse-ETF hedges within hours of the 2 April tariff shock via the Section 5 override, containing the trough at -6.44% versus SPY at -11.72% (528 bp downside advantage).
Kept the book inside 25% single-name caps with weekly drift checks, rebalancing Foundation (~1.0 beta), Growth (1.1), Crisis (0.0), and Ceasefire (0.6) sleeves as regime labels flipped.
Re-risked on an explicit April playbook rather than discretionary drift, finishing at -4.37% with 0.63 beta and preserving trade logs plus bi-weekly decision diaries.
Behavioural audit showed a 28.6% win rate and losses held roughly twice as long as winners; converted that into revised position-sizing and exit rules.
Defended the mandate with a 2,600-word investment-committee memo and 20-slide oral defence (422/430) covering architecture, logs, strategy, and client postmortem.

projects.description: Reproducible Python research stack that audits the BWC simulation book - factor models, Monte Carlo stress, and sub-second market pivots - firewalled from live execution.

highlights.text: Built a reproducible Python 3.13 research stack (uv, PEP 517) implementing Fama-French three-factor OLS, Black-Litterman allocation, and Kelly sizing from explicit assumptions rather than packaged screener defaults.
Reduced end-of-day market and macro analysis to sub-second pivots by normalising Polygon, yfinance, Alpaca, and FRED feeds into DuckDB with Polars and reusable regime labels.
Stress-tested the BWC book with 10,000 Monte Carlo paths and Cornish-Fisher VaR (5% VaR -2.56%, Sortino 3.49, Calmar 6.34, Jensen alpha 0.686), keeping simulation firewalled from live execution.
Exposed regime, attribution, and risk evidence through a Typer CLI plus Streamlit/Plotly views so the desk could interrogate results without reopening notebooks.
Hardened the toolchain with pre-commit checks, Ruff, Bandit, Deptry, MkDocs, Doppler-managed secrets, and immutable Appwrite snapshots so results remained reviewable and reproducible.

highlights.text: Led as primary developer and designer, owning the analytical workflow from data preparation and log-linear model design through interpretation and presentation.

highlights.text: Engineered an agent orchestration layer with tool routing, structured memory, retry policies, and mandatory human approval for high-risk actions.
Built an evaluation harness that compared task success, latency, token cost, tool reliability, and recovery across model and prompt changes.

projects.name: Generative Search Intelligence System
projects.description: Search and content-intelligence workflow spanning SEO, AEO, and generative discovery.

highlights.text: Translated search intent into answer-ready GEO and AEO briefs by connecting entity coverage, source quality, structured data, and distribution.
Designed an experiment dashboard that tied crawl coverage and citations to branded visibility, conversion, and performance change after each content release.

projects.name: Bloom - Creative Terminal Visualization
projects.description: 2026 creative-development project: physics-driven terminal bonsai simulation for constrained TTY environments and the Unix ricing community.

highlights.text: Architected a physics-driven terminal bonsai simulation in Python and Rich, rendering procedural branch growth, wind perturbation, and falling-petal particles at 60 frames per second in constrained TTY environments.
Implemented Sakura, Wisteria, Autumn, and Winter palettes through HSL interpolation, enabling runtime palette switching with no re-render latency through buffered screen-update cycles.
Built a deterministic procedural-generation engine for fractal branch topology, parameterising growth angles, bifurcation probability, and bloom density through configurable L-system approximations.

Engineered real-time petal physics for gravity, air resistance, terminal velocity, and wind-vector deflection, managing more than 200 concurrent entities with O(n) updates in a single-threaded asynchronous loop.
Exposed interactive wind direction, strength, turbulence, and damping through WASD controls, turning the animation into a responsive terminal experience for the Unix ricing community.
Maintained sub-50 ms frame latency across Kitty, Alacritty, iTerm2, and Windows Terminal through frame capping, buffered updates, and dirty-region rendering.
Shipped a reproducible uv and PEP 517 environment with a locked dependency graph, Ruff, Pyright, and pre-commit checks, preserving type safety and preventing dependency drift.

projects.name: The Bard - Static Publishing Engine
projects.description: 2026 full-stack architecture project within Project GANET, providing an article-first and host-neutral publishing engine for research and knowledge gardens.

highlights.text: Designed an article-first static publishing engine supporting Obsidian Markdown, hand-authored standalone HTML, and Pandoc-generated single-page HTML under one metadata registry with bidirectional wikilinks and backlink resolution.

Architected a Jinja2 templating layer around a Readest-derived reader engine, delivering themeable typography, focus-mode reading, and scroll-progress tracking while preserving a portable host-neutral dist artifact.
Implemented garden-graph visualisation, an atomic Google Drive mirror, and a GitHub Actions deployment pipeline, turning GANET's source material into a reproducible publishing workflow.

projects.name: Personal Brand and Digital Presence
projects.description: Raconteur is a personal narrative, brand, and publishing system spanning major channels and owned web properties.

highlights.text: Unified positioning across LinkedIn, Instagram, and kartavya.tech through a shared visual identity, headline, and content architecture.
Turned the owned website into the source of truth for projects and long-form evidence, giving shorter social profiles a consistent path back to substantive work.

projects.name: Restaurant Operations Platform for Independent Client
projects.description: Hospiteri was a client project delivering a full-stack operating system for an independent restaurant.

highlights.text: Delivered a full-stack restaurant platform that unified reservations, menu administration, point of sale, staff cashiering, and inventory control in one operating system.
Mapped reservations, menu, POS, staff, and inventory requirements into a structured data model and executable workflows before development, reducing ambiguity across the build.

Converted the initial paid build into a 2-month technical mentorship when the owner asked to learn the codebase, then remained core engineer while transferring day-to-day ownership through documentation and training.

projects.name: Global Development and Climate Hypothesis Testing
projects.description: Sainen was an independent research case testing economic development against emissions and net-zero policy commitments.
evidence: Canvas_Downloads/Fundamentals of Business Analytics - BAN-0200 - LON3/A1 - Hypothesis Test - Exploring the Relationship Between Economic Indicators and Global Development Outcomes Using Python/A1_BAN0200_Kartavya_Final_Hypothesis_testing.pdf

highlights.text: Merged GDP, emissions, and net-zero datasets into 10,199 country-year observations, then built a stratified 1,800-record sample spanning 191 countries.
Tested 2 policy hypotheses with correlation, ANOVA, and chi-square methods, finding significant GDP associations with emissions and legal climate commitments at p < 0.001.
Translated the results into a supplier-risk framework for carbon-border exposure, separating 3 market categories: legally committed, policy-only, and uncommitted.

projects.name: Noritake Hospitality Tableware Positioning Strategy
projects.description: Applied consulting case repositioning Noritake's tabletop capability for Asian hospitality partnerships.
evidence: Canvas_Downloads/Business Strategy - STR-0200 - LON6/A1- Industry Positioning Analysis - Mapping the Strategic Terrain/Kartavya_Noritake-A1_STR_submission.docx

highlights.text: Mapped Noritake's JPY 147 million tabletop loss against Asian hospitality whitespace using Blue Ocean Strategy and strategic-group analysis.

Applied Blue Ocean and strategic-group repositioning, then modelled 15% to 25% premium pricing across 40% to 50% of tabletop revenue to project USD 54 million to USD 90 million in incremental revenue.
Built the repositioning around a hotel configurator, 24 to 36 month partnership contracts, co-marketing, and sustainability-led supply-chain optimisation.
Delivered the Noritake repositioning as a director-grade strategy dossier - method-first exhibits, sourced comparables, and a defensible narrative arc for oral defence.

projects.name: Toast Hotel F&B Expansion Strategy
projects.description: Applied consulting case using a resource-based blueprint to extend Toast into hotel food and beverage operations.
evidence: Canvas_Downloads/Business Strategy - STR-0200 - LON6/A2- The Resource-Based Strategy Blueprint/A2_VRIO_Strategy_Toast_Kartavya.docx

highlights.text: Used VRIO to identify Toast's deployment capability across 156,000 locations and USD 186 billion in annual payment volume as the defensible base for a hotel F&B vertical.
Compared Toast's core restaurant economics with a 50-200-property hotel-chain model, deriving USD 120,000 ACV, 11.9:1 LTV/CAC versus 1.4:1 in core, and USD 6.82 billion incremental 10-year NPV.
Mapped a 100-day enterprise entry plan across pilot agreements, a hotel sales team, PMS partnerships, and explicit conversion and churn gates.
Packaged the Toast hotel-chain expansion case as a partner-grade slide and memo set with exhibit-linked assumptions for committee-style review.

projects.name: Octopus Energy Battery Integration Strategy
projects.description: Independent strategic teardown of utility-scale storage integration with Octopus Energy's technology platform.
evidence: Canvas_Downloads/Business Strategy - STR-0200 - LON6/A3- The Competitive Advantage Playbook/Octopus-Energy-Final-Strategy_Grp_6.docx

highlights.text: Recommended Option D, a GBP 150 million backward-integration move into utility-scale batteries connected to Kraken and PowerGuard, after testing industry pressure with Porter's Five Forces and Kraken's roughly 40% cost-to-serve advantage.
Prioritised the 200 to 400 MW battery path over three alternatives using RICE and scenario planning; it scored 253 and modelled GBP 160 million to GBP 220 million of impact.
Turned the recommendation into a 24-month roadmap with gates above 20% IRR, GBP 40 million in annual grid contracts, 93% availability, and pre-agreed pivot or partner contingencies.

projects.name: Walmart Capital Budgeting and Future-Proofing Model
projects.description: Independent strategic teardown: capital-budgeting model for a USD 100.76 billion Walmart automation and EV infrastructure programme with NPV, IRR, and sensitivity cases.
evidence: Canvas_Downloads/CM3 Future Proofing Challenge - CM3-FTP - LON1/Accounting & Finance Assignment 3. Team Final Project/CM3_Team_5_Acc&Fin_Final_Capital_Budgeting_Walmart_Lon1_Word.docx

highlights.text: Co-built a capital-budgeting model for a USD 100.76 billion Walmart automation, store-technology, and EV infrastructure programme from cash-flow, WACC, and allocation assumptions in the statements.

Derived a 7.8% WACC from CAPM equity cost, debt cost, capital weights, and a 21% tax rate, then discounted projected cash flows to USD 164.05 billion NPV, 15.7% IRR, 2.83 profitability index, and under-9-month discounted payback.
Stress-tested the programme across +/-20% revenue, WACC, and cost shocks and translated the grid into capital-allocation recommendations.

projects.name: Walmart Pfand Circular Retail Strategy
projects.description: Independent strategic teardown on Walmart reverse-vending, rewards, and accessible store operations.
evidence: Canvas_Downloads/CM3 Future Proofing Challenge - CM3-FTP - LON1/Report to the Board/Walmart_FutureProofing_Report_CM3_Team5_LON1.docx

highlights.text: Designed a Walmart+ reverse-vending roadmap with accessible kiosk UX, instant rewards, fraud detection, and a modelled scale phase covering more than 2,000 stores.

Defined a six-month pilot scorecard using UI error rates, operational reports, post-interaction surveys, and kiosk transactions, targeting 50% fewer errors, 40% fewer manual interventions, 15% higher satisfaction, and 25% higher kiosk sales.

projects.name: Samsung and Huawei Strategic Resilience Analysis
projects.description: Independent strategic teardown comparing Samsung and Huawei on technology, ESG, geopolitical exposure, and supply-chain resilience.
evidence: Canvas_Downloads/CM3 Future Proofing Challenge - CM3-FTP - LON1/Analyzing Huawei's Competitor's Strategy for Future Resilience and Proofing/Kartavya_CM3_ENT_Huawei_Vs_Samsung_Analysis.docx

highlights.text: Compared Samsung and Huawei using PitchBook and company data, connecting semiconductor depth and ESG commitments to geopolitical exposure and supply-chain resilience.
Built a risk register and opportunity map linking 3 nm manufacturing, USD 18.8 billion R&D, sanctions, circularity, and domestic sourcing to future market access.

projects.name: AstroPatshala Brand Naming and Voice System
projects.description: Parallel brand architecture work for AstroPatshala spanning naming methodology, voice, and brandbook development alongside venture operations.

highlights.text: Developed the AstroPatshala name through a Double Diamond and rhizomatic naming process, using a Chaldean numerology engine and pan-Asian phonetic constraints to evaluate candidates.
Produced AstroPatshala brand strategy, voice, and brandbook in parallel with the venture operating model, pricing system, and delivery architecture.

projects.name: Siya Menu Design and Restaurant Data Platform
projects.description: Standalone novel build: end-to-end on-property menu design for the Savi/SRBS F&B operation - taxonomy, composition, print/web output, BOM economics, elasticity tests, and a manager-ready parser-fed data platform. Work in progress on the live site and quick-commerce hooks.

highlights.text: Digitized every historical menu revision into a comparable design archive before any repricing or assortment decision on the same property restaurant.
Built a competitor menu corpus - traditional and non-traditional - mapped to target ICP and occasion use before elasticity work began.
Replaced informal call-and-chit ordering with a source-to-ingredient-to-SKU bill of materials tied to each menu line.
Identified category-placeholder ghost items with negligible velocity and repriced edge-case fillers the market would bear.
Ran short pricing experiments per item cluster to find ceiling price before margin erosion, then locked results in a failsafe Excel casebook.
Rebuilt menu design taxonomy - culinary families, seasonals, and rotational pop-ups - alongside client-facing composition, photography selection, and print-ready PDF output.
Built a parser on the live Excel model so managers could mark 86'd items and seasonal prices, feeding a modular restaurant site with delivery hooks and item-level performance pixels.

Extended the manager site with dynamic CSS, Three.js animation, allergen and FAQ content, and quick-commerce hooks - still slow-progress work in progress bundled into one handoff packet rather than a finished product claim.

projects.name: Hospitality and Venture Operations Automation
projects.description: Python cron automation across hotel mail, attendance, backups, revenue ingestion, ERP/POS hooks, and AstroPatshala micro-calculators.

highlights.text: Automated staff-attendance reminders and operational mail workflows across hotel properties with logged cron schedules and failure alerts.
Built backup and data-sync scripts with recovery paths tested during planned downtime windows.
Wrote weekly revenue ingestion scripts feeding the Excel and Power BI reporting layer that paired with front-desk reconciliation controls.
Sketched REST integrations between ERP, POS, and PMS systems to reduce manual re-keying across property operations.
Shipped AstroPatshala positional and directional chart calculators as a bundle of small production Python tools alongside document batch-processing utilities.

projects.name: Independent Risk Modelling and Control Design
projects.description: NDA-safe risk registers, FMEA, GTM risk trees, and independent credit/portfolio modelling spanning hospitality operations, venture launches, and spec-case finance methods.

highlights.text: Built hotel FMEA and operational risk registers during the Savi turnaround - mapping service failure modes, kill gates, and control owners.
Drafted GTM and market-risk trees for confidential venture launches without naming clients or claiming regulated advice.
Reapplied credit and portfolio-risk methods as independent modelling exercises with documented assumptions, stress trees, and control gates - without claiming regulated advice.
Produced crisis-prevention playbooks with escalation paths, documentation trails, and memos pairing quantitative risk signals with operating narrative.
Linked detection, decision, and audit-trail controls into a repeatable operating model for accountable stakeholder handoffs.

projects.name: Independent Legal Documentation and Filing Support
projects.description: Confidential documentation practice supporting counsel-directed drafting, affidavit preparation, filing logistics, and cross-jurisdiction corporate-record verification.

highlights.text: Prepared filing-ready civil and intellectual-property drafts from counsel dictation and record bundles - affidavits, indexes, and procedural cross-checks before chamber submission.
Built a repeatable affidavit workflow spanning fact chronology, exhibit mapping, and consistency checks against source documents.
Verified Indian corporate board resolutions and shareholder records against UK Companies House filings for multi-jurisdiction family-enterprise matters.
Ghost-typed and structurally edited legal memos and transaction papers under partner direction - preserving voice while tightening logic and citation hygiene.
Tracked court and registry deadlines, version control, and sign-off chains so counsel could file under time pressure.
